rising.en: After the attack on Benghazi port... Statement on the Libyan National Security Council

reports.en: After the attack on Benghazi port... Statement on the Libyan National Security Council

reports.t: الناطق باسم مجلس النواب الليبي: رئاسة المجلس ستعقد اجتماعا طارئا اليوم لبحث الاعتداءات على ميناء بنغازي
reports.en: Speaker of the Libyan House of Representatives: Presidency of the Council will hold an emergency meeting today to examine attacks on the port of Benghazi.

reports.t: عضو المجلس الرئاسي الليبي موسى الكوني: الهجوم على بنغازي بمثابة إعلان حرب وندعو مجلس الأمن لجلسة طارئة
reports.en: Member of the Libyan Presidential Council, Moussa Kuni: the attack on Benghazi is a declaration of war and call on the Security Council for an emergency meeting.

rating: Stars combine the kind of newsroom (public broadcaster or news agency 5, newspaper or business daily 4, broadcaster or digital site 3.5, tabloid or state-controlled 2.5) with its reach in the country (top 3 +0.5, ranks 8-10 -0.25). State-controlled outlets are labelled as such.
